digest.component_or_area: Jira DC capability mapping CI job
propositions: An on-demand GitHub Actions workflow (dispatch-only, never auto-triggered) boots the pinned amd64 Jira DC image and interrogates its REST API to produce a structured, committed environment contract instead of discovering capabilities at test time

The workflow must answer a specific checklist of questions: which project template yields Epic, the field IDs for Epic Link and Epic Name, screen presence, whether REST-based issue type creation and screen field addition work, and the results of two previously-recorded falsifier tests on tickets 37e7 and 1a9f

The four rebar vocabulary maps (priority, issue type, status, link type) must be validated against the live instance with structured verdicts (present / absent / present-but-different), and link directions must be verified end-to-end because name-only checks cannot catch inverted dependencies

Five hardcoded field length limits (summary, label, description, comment, ADF) and the instance property jira.text.field.character.limit must be measured by writing at limit-1/limit/limit+1 and detecting accept-and-truncate by read-back comparison, not by trusting successful writes

The image digest must be derived from the Dockerfile's FROM line at runtime and committed to the artifact with provenance so a re-pin produces observable staleness; nothing can drift between the two jobs

Every REST call's raw request and response must be captured into an evidence list so the contract remains traceable to evidence, not to an LLM summary, and the answer data is committed as authored documentation, not re-derived at test time
